purpose: Keep repo root readable by relocating transport-only APPLY scripts and file manifests into SUPPORT/TRANSPORT.
proof_requirements: root contains no APPLY_*.ps1 after relocation
each relocated file exists in canonical destination
sha256 before relocation equals sha256 after relocation
each relocated file appears in transport index
each relocated file appears in Administratum registry
notes: This patch may relocate its own root APPLY script and file manifest after extraction.
That is intended; patch provenance remains inside WARP/PATCHES and SUPPORT/TRANSPORT.
